hooks.name: Engine guard

action.command: cmd /c "git diff --quiet HEAD -- packages/morse_core || (cd packages\morse_core && dart test > ..\..\.kiro\evidence\engine-guard.log 2>&1 && echo PASS >> ..\..\.kiro\evidence\engine-guard.log || echo FAIL >> ..\..\.kiro\evidence\engine-guard.log)"

hooks.description: After each agent turn, if anything under packages/morse_core changed since the last commit, run its tests and save the result to .kiro/evidence/engine-guard.log.
